meta.source: Conquest × Shapeshift colors, Cantina style canvas (https://claude.ai/artifact/L6M24BzoY4UfwAL2cJpAV3), 2026-11-09

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background around the dungeon (character setup, XP event, action bar). Shapeshift's light grid ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, text fields, picker tiles, secondary buttons, chips on the map. Always with a 2px ink border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text on ground and surface (21:1 on surface, 17:1 on ground), every border, every hard shadow, info chips.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The one accent. Means yours, selected or next: primary buttons, the selected picker tile, XP fill, the title slab, the next-boss marker. As text only on ground or surface (7:1 on ground) and at 24px+.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue (8.6:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Secondary fills and a character accent option. Never text: it fails on ground and surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Header band laid over the dungeon map, so white text reads on any dungeon theme.

styles.name: reward
styles.usage: The XP amount on a reward screen, in blue on ground. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Talk titles on the next-boss card and other card headings.

styles.name: slab
styles.usage: Screen title, set on the blue title slab.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Conquest wordmark, uppercase. There is no logo mark yet.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Quest names and screen headers next to an icon button.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, uppercase. 20px on the full-width call to action.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Made from your LinkedIn. Change anything.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Matches your goal: learn vector search.
styles.usage: Supporting lines: why a talk was picked, speaker names, XP breakdowns.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, uppercase, between two ink rules.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips: times, rooms, XP amounts, map tags.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Only inside the dungeon layer: the number that floats over the character. White with a 3px ink drop. Never in brand UI.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Small offset: picker tile press distance.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between outfit tiles, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and headers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, colour swatches. The title slab stays square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Picker tiles, text fields, icon buttons, day pills.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the next-boss ring.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: XP bar track (half its height).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: picker tiles, icon buttons, day pills, action bar buttons, chips with a border.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards and primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-on-scrim
tokens.usage: The selected day pill on the dark map header.

tokens.name: ring-selected
tokens.usage: Selected colour swatch: a ground gap, then a blue ring, so a blue swatch still reads as selected.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Every border on surface elements, in ink.

tokens.name: stroke-cta
tokens.usage: Outline around the full-width call to action.
